links.outcome: Expert-rated authenticity of references cited in chatbot answers
links.effect: Reference dissatisfaction was 75% (91/128) to 97% (119/128) in some ChatGPT modes, while Arkangel AI-Deep, ChatGPT-Deep, and OpenEvidence had 100% satisfaction for this criterion.
links.quote: Dissatisfaction was most frequent for reference authenticity in some ChatGPT modes (75% [n 91/128]-97% [n 119/128]), whereas Arkangel AI-Deep, ChatGPT-Deep, and OpenEvidence showed 100% satisfaction for this criterion.

unlisted_practices: Comparing LLM chatbots head-to-head on multidimensional expert-rated validity criteria and response time

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of 4 commercial LLM chatbots on clinical vignette questions evaluated by medical specialists across multiple safety and validity criteria, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
